name: Crown Cribbage
summary: 支持 2–4 人的数字版克里比奇纸牌游戏，含在线牌桌、轮流同屏与电脑对手。 Steam 开发者披露：游戏内音乐由 AI 音乐工具生成；商店主视觉（capsule/key art）与营销文案草稿借助生成式 AI 制作；编程过程中使用了生成式 AI 辅助。其他领域未被披露提及。

disclosureQuote: Some assets in Crown Cribbage were made with the help of generative AI tools: in-game music was generated with AI music tools; capsule/key art; marketing copy drafts; assistance with programming. The computer opponents in this game are not generative AI. No AI content of any kind is created during a match.
